brief.headline: Push for ₹250/KG on laminates — market data shows ₹205–305/kg is fair and we already pay ₹250/KG to Silk Polypack

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹250/KG for the laminate SKU, down from ₹385/KG
priceAsk.basis: We pay Silk Polypack ₹250.00/KG for the same material (54.0% gap). Market research says pharma/ORS sachet laminate asks run ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — so ₹385/KG is well above fair. Even the raw BOPET import benchmark sits at 171.60 ₹/kg.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Ask to move from 60 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹5325 of our cash; a further 15-day cut frees another ₹2663

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, cash position or how much we matter to them. That means we lean hard on our own purchase data and on having credible backup suppliers ready. Our annual spend with them is only ₹64788 — small enough that walking away won't hurt us. The price gap and the lineup of alternates below give us room to push firmly on both price and payment terms.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹385.00/KG but Silk Polypack charges us ₹250.00/KG for laminates
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate runs ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg
The overpay costs us ₹22718 a year on this one SKU
Even raw BOPET film imports land at 171.60 ₹/kg — well below what we pay UFLEX for finished laminate
Cutting payment terms from 60 to 30 days frees ₹5325 of our cash
Our total spend with UFLEX is tiny — ₹64788 a year — so switching costs us nothing

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volumes — proven and scalable for laminate sachets

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, pharma blister and sachet specialist — strong second source (health score D 31/100, revenue ₹222.04 Cr)

alternates.name: Polyplex Corporation Limited (lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead from public research; medium confidence — needs audit and pricing before we can RFQ

risks: UFLEX's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their stability — watch for any supply hiccups and keep the alternate pipeline warm
Our ₹64788 spend is tiny to them — they may not budge much, so be ready to shift volume to Huhtamaki or Constantia if they stonewall
The ₹250/KG benchmark comes from Silk Polypack and open-market asks, not an RFQ from UFLEX's direct competitors — run a mini-RFQ with Huhtamaki and Constantia to lock the number before the meeting
Market backup leads (Polyplex, Garware, SRF, Ester, Jindal, Constantia Flexibles) are unqualified — do not treat them as approved alternates until we audit and price them
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the ₹135/KG gap on laminates — Silk Polypack gives us ₹250/KG and the market data backs that up, so let's talk about how we get there and tighten payment terms at the same time.
